facts.fact: Main site is the National Shared Services Center in Abuja, an Uptime-certified Tier III facility; its backup, Galaxy Backbone's Kano 'Data Recovery and Business Continuity' centre, is said to meet Tier IV standards (main site in Abuja, backup in Kano); construction was completed and the centre was 'ready to launch', not stated in service.
